senses.gloss: m. (סָדַר) one who arranges traditions systematically, systematic scholar, opp. פילפלן dialectician. Y. Hor. III, 48ᶜ top הסו׳ (Bab. ed. הסד׳).
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 87:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXVII</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Kings 20:20">II Kings XX, 20</cite>) ‘he brought the water (of the Law) into the city’, <he>שהוא סו׳</he> because he (Ezekiah) was a collector, v. <cite ref="O00209">next w.</cite>
